scope: Real-model native editor trials; not professional acceptance

trials.failure: Model confused controller action name with a granted native tool; strict host boundary rejected it.

trials.main_finding: The actual neural model spent 19/22 decisions on metadata discovery/schema descriptions, repeatedly inspecting the absent native project and eventually sending invalid inspect_clip inputs. Model-facing native observation text was cleared after each metadata decision; this was separately identified in the controller source, not validated as the only cause of failure.
trials.measured_inference_wall_seconds_scope: sum of 22 RecordedModel actual HTTP decision timings, not whole GitHub job wall time

offline_context_projection.note: Same 22 historical context payloads, replacing ONLY latest_events with bounded projection; not actual new model inference, not verified model token savings, latency improvement, quality or autonomous video success.

actual_model_context_utf8_bytes.measurement: serialized inference-transcript.jsonl context objects with ensure_ascii=False and compact separators

trials.failure: Tool schemas permitted unspecified extra top-level fields, so the model's hallucinated open_project keys passed preflight and the real native host rejected the call; no project/edit/export was produced.
trials.next_proposed_fix: Model-only top-level declared-parameter admission plus host-derived bounded parameter-name hints; no changes to the native host schema or creative input values.

trials.failure: Two model input-shape errors were correctly stopped before editor RPC. A subsequent read-only inspect_export_file on a nonexistent export was dispatched, failed, and unnecessarily terminated the session because the controller had not received trusted host read/write grants.
trials.proposed_change: Pass trusted host grant map to controller and independent audit so *reported read-only errors* may be followed by model-chosen correction; write or unknown errors still stop.

trials.actual_native_editor_calls_detail: One host-initiated read-only get_project plus one model-selected import_asset_from_path
trials.failure: The host produced a true absent-project snapshot before neural inference. The pinned 2B model nevertheless attempted import_asset_from_path without an existing open project. The real native editor failed closed; no project, edit or export was produced.
trials.decision_implication: Project sensing is working. Tool argument safety is working. Neural multi-step precondition comprehension remains insufficient; evaluate the replaceable brain rather than merely adding ad hoc controller patches.

trials.root_cause: In compact indexed discovery mode, unconstrained invoke.tool JSON string let 2B model mistake the protocol action search for a native editor tool; BODY rejected it before any native dispatch.
trials.next_fix: Only the small set of tools returned by live host-granted search may appear in the next model's structured invoke/describe grammar; no giant static tool enumeration.

actual_model_context_utf8_bytes.measurement: serialized inference-transcript.jsonl context objects with ensure_ascii=False and compact separators

context_comparison.validity: Different real CPU-model sessions and model decisions; per-turn serialized context bytes only, NOT a controlled token, latency, creativity or reliability benchmark.

trials.root_cause: 2B model falsely declared a fully created, saved and exported native project on its first decision, contradicted by real host project=null/hasProject=false and zero native writes or exports.
trials.next_safety_fix: Host-owned generic required_evidence gate refuses premature finish; does not select creative actions or count model prose as an artifact.

preflight_rejection.reason: width/height/fps were sent as strings rather than native integer/number schema

trials.terminal_native_error_cause: Model passed an MP4 source-asset path as a native project path
trials.observed_root_cause: An already host-advertised exact operation create_project was hidden behind lexical-tie requires_refinement across repeated searches. Model then made invalid project-creation arguments and a mistaken native project-open call. Multiple independent model/operation errors remain beyond retrieval.
trials.candidate_fix: Preserve ambiguous broad-search refusal, but resolve an exact host-granted native name or source-qualified operation ID before lexical ranking. Not evidence that the model can complete a creative video.

trials.root_cause: The indexed exact-ID fix #101 enabled real model-controlled creation of an editable empty Velorn project. After successful create_project, the controller invalidated project presence to 'unknown' rather than independently re-reading get_project. The 2B model then searched broad terms, repeatedly retried create_project on an already existing project, and stopped on a reported native write error. This run proves neither media editing nor export.
trials.next_safety_fix: Use one trusted post-write get_project READ after a model-chosen project_open enabling operation, record immutable read evidence and preserve actual project identity in the next inference context. Still requires independent live model end-to-end trial.
trials.source_proof_scope: Runner-uploaded ZIP SHA independently checked in artifact reader; project.comfystudio contained one empty timeline and no assets. Human creative acceptance not attempted.

trials.root_cause: The stronger 4B independently selected create_project but used its default previewOnly=true, receiving a host response with success=false, result.previewOnly=true and no applied project. A second model-selected create_project with previewOnly=false created an empty native project. The controller nonetheless counted the preview plan as a successful native write. Project presence was then set to unknown; the model repeatedly invoked create_project and terminated on a native reported write error without timeline edits/exports.
trials.next_safety_fix: Distinguish preview-only host responses from acknowledged applied writes, independently read actual native project presence after create/open when granted read-only access, and preserve proof that 2B/4B failed real creative acceptance. Do not claim performance superiority from these different incomplete runs.

trials.model_memory_scope: VmHWM exact live llama-server PID only, excluding editor, OS and cgroup
trials.failure: Despite successful real model-chosen project creation and source-attested reads, the 2B model repeatedly searched and invoked create_project again, including after actual project_open=true. A redundant final create reported a native error. The artifact contains two editable but empty saved project files, no imported assets, clips or exported movie.
trials.next_safety_fix: A trial-scoped host rule refuses subsequent acknowledged create_project writes before native dispatch, while enabling the model to independently search further available tools. Distinguish real application status from transport success. This does not claim working autonomous editing.
trials.evidence_source: Independently inspected GitHub Actions artifact ZIP: evidence.json, inference-transcript.jsonl, native-journal.jsonl, two project.comfystudio. ZIP SHA256 is from Actions upload log. All outcomes are technical trial evidence, not artistic acceptance.
